audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty was described only in generic terms and the content layer never named a single one of her abilities, so 'her dash combo and chain CC' could have been any bruiser.
audit.why: 41.67% over 12 games is a losing matchup, and the reason is specific: Drakehound's Step bolts a dash onto every ability she casts, so she closes on Kassadin without spending a cooldown to do it.
audit.corrected: Named Drakehound's Step, Cunning Sweep/Sundering Slam, Repudiation, Lacerate and Public Execution across both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: No spike carried a cooldown number, and the ult was never mentioned as a spike at all.
audit.why: Public Execution is 130/115/100s - the longest cooldown in the lane - and Cunning Sweep is 14s at rank 1. Those two numbers define when you can walk forward.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, report[9].t and loading now carry them.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer tracked a fabricated ability called 'Dash Chain' in eighteen separate fields, including the focus badge. Ambessa has no such ability. Two real interactions were missing entirely: (1) Repudiation deals INCREASED damage if she blocked non-minion damage while bracing, so throwing Null Sphere into her brace makes her slam hit harder; (2) Public Execution blinks to the FARTHEST enemy champion in the line she picks, so your position relative to your team decides whether she takes you.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'If she blocked any non-minion damage while bracing herself, this ability will deal increased damage' and 'Ambessa blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line of her choosing and suppresses them upon her arrival'.
audit.corrected: Replaced every 'Dash Chain' with the real ability, and wrote both interactions into report[5].t, dosFull[0], loading and content.wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: The punishable window was described as 'the chain is spent' with no cooldown.
audit.why: Cunning Sweep is 14/13/12/11/10s and Lacerate is 13/12/11/10/9s, but Drakehound's Step is a passive with no cooldown - so 'wait for her dash' is never true. The window is her Q and E, not her mobility.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten around Cunning Sweep and Lacerate.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer called Ambessa 'he' and 'his' throughout.
audit.why: Ambessa is female; the content layer already used 'her'.
audit.corrected: Fixed tldr, winCon, report[0].t, report[1].t, dontsFull[0].t, tradeGood, breakdown.trading and report[3].t.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are a knife-fight you mostly want to refuse — her dash combo and W damage out-trade everything you have while your only answer is the brief shield off Null Sphere. You're both fragile at level 1, so contest CS at max Q range and don't throw the orb where she can dash on top of you. The moment her dash and chain CC are online, treat every step into her range as a coin flip and just farm — your Q is too mana-hungry and short to win a poke war here.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are a knife-fight I mostly want to refuse - Cunning Sweep into Repudiation out-trades everything I have while my only answer is the brief shield off Null Sphere. We are both fragile at level 1, so contest CS at max Q range and never throw the orb into her W brace, because everything it blocks makes her slam hit harder. Once Lacerate is online, treat every step into her 325 range as a coin flip and just farm - my Q is too mana-hungry to win a poke war here.

notes: FABRICATED NAME: the full layer tracked 'Ambessa Dash Chain' in eighteen fields including focus.text. No such ability exists - the mechanic is Drakehound's Step (P), which is a passive with NO cooldown, so all the 'fight when the chain is spent' advice was unactionable as written. FLAG MISFIRES on ambessa.json: Public Execution carries heal and grounding flags and Repudiation carries grounding, none of which appear in Riot's descriptions - so I did not write the _missing-interactions 'needs-antiheal (Public Execution)' line. Public Execution suppresses; whether QSS or Cleanse breaks it is not in the kit data, so nothing was written about it.
